title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics + parity fixes, version bumps v1.30.1
author: Ava Martinez
description: This PR unifies auth + retry behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, improves streaming ergonomics (first-class async iterators / event callbacks), fixes a few parity bugs between SDKs, and bumps SDK package versions to v1.30.1 (minor patch). Motivation: reduce behavioral drift observed in downstream integrations and provide a single, predictable retry/auth surface for hosted and private deployments. Key changes: - Consolidated auth token refresh flow and expose a common credential interface across SDKs - Standardized retry/backoff configuration and default policy (idempotent vs non-idempotent heuristics) - Streaming API ergonomics: Python async iterator, TS readable stream + event emitter helper, Go channel-based streaming helper - Bug fixes: consistent metadata headers, streaming error propagation, deterministic cancellation behavior - Version bumps and changelog updates. Checklist: - [x] Python SDK changes implemented and unit tested - [x] TypeScript SDK changes implemented and integration tested with examples - [x] Go SDK helper implemented and e2e smoke tested - [x] Changelogs and release notes updated - [x] CI green (one flaky test re-run) See commits for granular changes and PR comments for review discussion. Related Linear: ENG-1428, ENG-1499.
commits: feat(python): add unified credential adapter + auto-refresh
feat(ts): streaming helper (EventEmitter) + retry policy consolidation
feat(go): streaming channel helper + unified retry config
fix(python): propagate stream errors to iterator consumer
chore(sdk): bump python/ts/go versions to v1.30.1
docs: update changelogs and migration guide
